title: Coffee Shop Chat
locationRef: A quiet corner café, mid-morning. Soft jazz, low chatter, warm light.
setup: You sit down near someone who's reading. They glance up briefly and give a small nod.
storyPlot: You ducked into this café to escape the noise of the high street — a coffee, a seat, maybe a quiet moment. The corner table you picked has two chairs, and you've ended up sitting closer to a stranger than you intended. They have a book open in front of them, a half-drunk flat white beside it, and the easy self-sufficiency of someone who's comfortable being alone. You don't know anything about them yet — not their name, not their story. But something about the morning light and the low hum of the café makes this feel like the kind of place where a conversation could quietly happen, if you let it.
openingLine: Alex looks up from his book. 'Oh — sorry, I didn't realise someone was sitting here. All good.'
failureCondition: Composite score < 35 OR NPC mood reaches 'cold' twice
